gloss: to go to pick someone up; to go to meet someone

definitions.gloss: to go to pick someone up; to go to meet and bring someone back
definitions.explanation: To travel to a location in order to meet someone and accompany or transport them back. Commonly used for picking up children, guests, or family members.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to pick up my child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the airport to pick up my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}こう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: It started raining, so shall I go to the station with an umbrella to pick you up?

notes:
A very common everyday expression using the pattern verb stem + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go in order to do something). The verb ⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ means to welcome or receive, and combined with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ it specifically means going somewhere to meet and bring someone back.

USAGE:
- {迎|むか}えに{行|い}く means you go to the other person's location
- ⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ means someone comes to your location to pick you up
- Often used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to specify who you're picking up: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to pick up one's child
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to go to the airport to pick someone up
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to go to the station to meet someone
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to go pick someone up by car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come to pick someone up — the reverse perspective
- ⟦{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え→送り迎え：14362_okurimukae⟧: pickup and drop-off — the noun form covering both directions
